exposure: non-use of a labour monitoring tool
non-use of uterotonic for PPH prevention
cohort: 76,563 women admitted for delivery or complications within 42 days of delivery or termination of pregnancy from September 2019 to August 2020 across 54 Nigerian referral-level hospitals.
finding: Key predictors of maternal and perinatal death included low maternal education, lack of antenatal care, referral from another facility, previous caesarean section, latent-phase labour admission, operative vaginal birth, non-use of a labour monitoring tool, no labor companion, and non-use of uterotonic for PPH prevention.
followup_time: 42 days postpartum or until termination of pregnancy
